dailyTarot.eyebrow: With Yeoni · Destiny Tea House cards · once a day
dailyTarot.title: Three cards to open your day
dailyTarot.subtitle: While the tea steeps, listen to your heart for a moment.
dailyTarot.freeHint: Free, no sign-in needed. New cards arrive once a day.
dailyTarot.aboutBody: Destiny Tea House cards read your heart, your flow and one small action. It is a symbolic tarot reading, separate from saju, sukuyo, Vedic or numerology calculations.
dailyTarot.guide2Body: Choose the cards your heart lingers on. You can change them before they are turned.
dailyTarot.guide3Body: The three cards open one by one, followed by the reading.
dailyTarot.pickTitle: Pick three cards your heart lingers on
dailyTarot.pickHint: Tap a picked card again to undo it.
dailyTarot.revealHint: Tap a card to turn the rest at once.
dailyTarot.readingTitle: Weaving the story of the three cards
dailyTarot.verdictLabel: Today · the conclusion of all three cards
dailyTarot.fallbackQuote: “You do not have to answer all three cards. One thing that stays with you today is enough.”
dailyTarot.fallbackNote: The full reading could not be loaded. Reopen the page to read it again.
dailyTarot.paidTitle: Want to go deeper with your own question?
dailyTarot.paidBody: This free reading looks at the structure of the cards. At the tea house you can write a question and draw three new cards, and Yeoni will read them at length for your situation. One follow-up question is included.
dailyTarot.endingNote: You can reread these cards today. Three new cards will be waiting tomorrow.
dailyTarot.sharedBody: Only the card symbols were shared, with no personal details or question.
dailyTarot.newDayBody: A new day has come. Finish reading your last cards, or start today's three fresh.
dailyTarot.storageNote: This browser cannot save, so you can only see the result during this visit.

healingTarot.title: Today's recovery energy
healingTarot.subtitle: From where your heart grew tired to one recovery action for today, four cards light the way.
healingTarot.aboutBody: Four cards from the 78-card deck read where your heart grew tired, the temperature of your feelings, a clue to recovery and a recovery action for today.
healingTarot.guide1Body: All 78 cards are shuffled and four are drawn.
healingTarot.guide2Body: The cards open one by one in position order.
healingTarot.guide3Body: See a reading for each card and a recovery routine for today.
healingTarot.revealHint: Tap a card to turn the rest at once.

freeSaju.title: See my Four Pillars from my birth date
freeSaju.subtitle: Calculated for Seoul time. Leave the birth time empty if you don't know it.
freeSaju.freeHint: Free, no sign-in needed. Your birth date is not sent to a server.
freeSaju.aboutBody: From your birth date and calendar type we set up the year, month, day and hour pillars, then tell you in one line how the five elements are spread.
freeSaju.guide2Body: Choose solar, lunar or lunar leap month.
freeSaju.guide3Body: It's fine not to know. Leave it empty and the hour pillar shows as unknown.
freeSaju.timeTitle: Do you know your birth time?
freeSaju.timeHint: If you don't know, leave it empty and tap Next.
freeSaju.computingBody: Matching the four pillars and five elements.

webtoon.disclaimer: Tarot is a tool for reflecting on your heart; it does not settle the future or what someone else feels.

yeoni.name: Yeoni
yeoni.opening1: Let's open today's three cards together, starting with your day.
yeoni.opening2: Your three cards are speaking about today. We will read them in order.
yeoni.upright1: {position}: {card}. Look for the strength you can use here.
yeoni.upright2: For {position}, {card}. It shows the path that is open now.
yeoni.upright3: This one is {card}. It shows what you can lean on in {position}.
yeoni.reversed1: {card}, reversed in {position}. Time to look at where things paused.
yeoni.reversed2: {card} reversed. Slow down and look again at {position}.
yeoni.reversed3: {card} upside down. Gently pick up what you missed in {position}.
yeoni.caution1: {card} in {position} is a heavier scene. Read it as a place to check, not to fear.
yeoni.caution2: {card} in {position}. No rush here; check once more.
yeoni.synthesis1: Put the three together and the flow appears. Here is the gist first.
yeoni.synthesis2: Let's follow the line between the cards: the flow and what to watch.
yeoni.step1: Just this one thing is enough today. Try it small and look back tonight.
yeoni.step2: A small step suits today better than a big resolution. Try just one.
yeoni.closing1: That's today's three cards. Let's open your day together again tomorrow.
yeoni.closing2: Thank you for reading to the end. Keep the one line that stayed with you.
yeoni.fallback: Let's calmly read the scene the cards are showing.
yeoni.mindFallback: Notice which scene comes to your own mind first.

yeongnyangi.name: Yeongnyangi
yeongnyangi.opening1: You're here. Let's open the three cards you picked.
yeongnyangi.opening2: Your cards are out. I'll walk you through the flow.
yeongnyangi.upright1: {position}: {card}. Let's see the path open to you.
yeongnyangi.upright2: For {position}, {card}. There is strength to use here.
yeongnyangi.upright3: This one is {card}. It shows what to lean on in {position}.
yeongnyangi.reversed1: {card}, reversed in {position}. Look at where things paused.
yeongnyangi.reversed2: {card} reversed. It says slow down in {position}.
yeongnyangi.reversed3: {card} upside down. Just pick up what you missed.
yeongnyangi.caution1: {card} in {position} is a heavy scene. Nothing to fear, just check it.
yeongnyangi.caution2: {card} in {position}. No rush; check once more.
yeongnyangi.synthesis1: Line the three up and the flow shows. Here's my call first.
yeongnyangi.synthesis2: Let's follow the line between the cards: flow and what to watch.
yeongnyangi.step1: Just this one today. Try it small and look back tonight.
yeongnyangi.step2: No big resolutions. One small step, that is all.
yeongnyangi.closing1: That's it for today's three. Come back tomorrow.
yeongnyangi.closing2: Hmph, you read to the end. Keep the one line that stayed.
yeongnyangi.fallback: Let's calmly read the scene the cards show.
yeongnyangi.mindFallback: See which scene comes to your own mind first.

animalDestiny.title: Find your destiny animal
animalDestiny.subtitle: From your birth date we read your day stem and twelve life stages, then find the animal that resembles you.
animalDestiny.freeHint: You can see the basic result without logging in.
animalDestiny.aboutBody: We match the energy of the day you were born with the flow of the twelve life stages and show the animal that mirrors your nature and its daily rhythm.
animalDestiny.guide1Body: If you saved a profile, pick it to fill this in at once.
animalDestiny.guide2Body: It is fine not to know. Leave it blank or choose prefer not to say.
animalDestiny.guide3Body: Used on your result card. You can leave it empty.
animalDestiny.timeTitle: Do you know your birth time?
animalDestiny.timeHint: If you do not know, leave it blank and tap Next.
animalDestiny.nameTitle: Which name should the result card use?
animalDestiny.nameHint: You can leave it blank and tap Next.
animalDestiny.computingBody: Matching your day stem with the twelve life stages.

starHug.title: Let Yeon hold your heart today
starHug.subtitle: With your mood, your sign and one worry, Yeon reads today's heart constellation card for you.
starHug.aboutBody: Yeon matches the mood you pick with your birth sign and makes a comforting message and a symbol card for today.
starHug.guide1Body: Pick the mood closest to how you feel.
starHug.guide2Body: If you have a saved profile, pick it to fill this in.
starHug.guide3Body: Confirm the sign matched from your birth date, or pick one yourself.
starHug.guide4Body: Write what is on your mind, or pick a sample sentence.
starHug.emotionTitle: Which feeling is closest right now?
starHug.birthTitle: Would you share your birth date?
starHug.birthHint: It's fine if you don't know. Leave it blank and tap next.
starHug.concernTitle: Anything you want to tell Yeon?
starHug.concernHint: Leave it blank and Yeon will read today's overall mood.
starHug.readingTitle: Yeon is reading your heart constellation
starHug.readingBody: Matching your mood and sign to pick today's card.

ynFreeFortune.title: Pick one of today's 16 readings
ynFreeFortune.subtitle: Choose a field and write one line about what you wonder. Yeongnyangi will read today's story for you.
ynFreeFortune.freeHint: Unlocked with today's anchovies. Reading again won't cost more anchovies.
ynFreeFortune.aboutBody: Get today's reading from one of 16 fields such as saju, astrology and tarot. Fields that need birth details use the profile you picked.
ynFreeFortune.guide1Body: Pick the reading you want today from the 16.
ynFreeFortune.guide2Body: Write a question or leave it blank. For birth-based fields, pick your profile above.
ynFreeFortune.guide3Body: A reading you open stays the same for the rest of today.

mingriTarot.eyebrow: Mingri Tarot · 78 cards · three cards free
mingriTarot.title: Lay out three cards for one concern
mingriTarot.subtitle: Choose the door of your concern, then read the path so far, the present texture and your next guideline in turn.
mingriTarot.freeHint: Free without signing in. Your result is not saved.
mingriTarot.aboutBody: We layer the Ten Gods onto the symbols of the 78 tea-house cards to read the guideline to hold for the concern you chose. It is a symbolic tarot reading, separate from Saju calculation.
mingriTarot.guide1Body: Pick one of eight: today, love, reunion, career, money and more.
mingriTarot.guide2Body: From the shuffled 78, pick three cards your heart rests on.
mingriTarot.guide3Body: The three cards open in turn, followed by a reading for each position and a synthesis.
mingriTarot.pickTitle: Choose three cards your heart rests on
mingriTarot.pickHint: Swipe sideways to browse. Tap a chosen card again to undo.
mingriTarot.revealHint: Tap a card to reveal the rest at once.
mingriTarot.readingTitle: Connecting the story of the three cards
mingriTarot.fallbackLabel: We could not load the full synthesis
mingriTarot.fallbackBody: Here are the cards by position first. Lay them out again to see the synthesis.
mingriTarot.paidTitle: Want to go deeper with your own question?
mingriTarot.paidBody: The free reading covers the card structure; a tea-house consultation adds an answer, reasons, action advice and one follow-up question.

astro.title: Let's unfold the sky of the moment you were born
astro.subtitle: Tell us your name, birth date, time and place step by step, and we'll open your birth chart.
astro.freeHint: The basic birth chart is free.
astro.aboutBody: From your birth date, time and place we calculate the Sun, Moon, Ascendant and planets to read your tendencies and flow.
astro.guide1Body: Choose the name and gender for your chart.
astro.guide2Body: Knowing the time makes the Ascendant accurate. You can continue without it.
astro.guide3Body: With a place, we adjust for longitude and time zone.
astro.openBody: We'll fill your details into the profile screen. Save it and your astrology chart opens right away.

sukuyo.subtitle: Tell us your name and birth date step by step, and we'll open your birth mansion.
sukuyo.freeHint: The basic Sukuyo reading is free.
sukuyo.aboutBody: We find which of the 27 lunar mansions the Moon was passing on your birthday and read your tendencies and relationships from it.
sukuyo.guide1Body: Choose the name and gender for your reading.
sukuyo.guide2Body: Pick solar or lunar and we calculate the Moon's mansion for that day.
sukuyo.guide3Body: You can save it with your profile. You can continue without it.
